purpose: Protect the travel-booklet memory and acquisition footer in all sharing flows.

expect: Aracne answers are automatically saved in the local travel booklet
saved entries retain language, timestamp and available territory/POI/route context
closing the assistant does not remove the saved answer
the booklet can contain Aracne answers and user notes
entry count uses generic entry wording rather than note-only wording
route shares contain the app open/install footer
trip shares contain the app open/install footer
booklet shares contain the app open/install footer
assistant answer shares contain the app open/install footer
photo shares contain the app open/install footer
mission photo shares contain the app open/install footer
the share footer uses the current public app URL or canonical URL
no fake App Store or Google Play URL is claimed
